mapper.sql: grp_cd, grp_cd_nm, dc, sort_ord, use_at, etc_1, reg_dt, rgtr, mdfcn_dt, mdfr
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_com_grp_cd (grp_cd, grp_cd_nm, dc, sort_ord, use_at, etc_1, rgtr) VALUES (#{grpCd}, #{grpCdNm}, #{dc}, #{sortOrd}, #{useAt}, #{etc1}, #{rgtr})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_com_grp_cd SET grp_cd_nm = #{grpCdNm}, dc = #{dc}, sort_ord = #{sortOrd}, use_at = #{useAt}, etc_1 = #{etc1}, mdfcn_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, mdfr = #{mdfr} WHERE grp_cd = #{grpCd}
